# temps_otel_dashboard (Resource)

A saved dashboard of a project's OpenTelemetry metrics and logs: sections of chart tiles.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `otel:read`, `otel:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_otel_dashboard" "service" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  name       = "Service health"
  layout = jsonencode({
    sections = [{
      id    = "http"
      title = "HTTP"
      tiles = [{
        id          = "latency"
        title       = "p95 latency"
        metric_name = "http.server.duration"
        aggregation = "p95"
        chart       = "line"
      }]
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `layout` (String) Sections and their tiles: `jsonencode({ sections = [{ id = "http", title = "HTTP", tiles = [...] }] })`. Values Temps fills in for a tile left out of the configuration are not compared. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `name` (String) Name of the dashboard.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_otel_dashboard.service 8/3
```
